Target-Safe Causal Physical Tokens for Embodied World Models
papers.summary: This paper introduces Target-Safe Causal Physical Tokens (TS-CPT) as a target-relative physical state representation for embodied world models. TS-CPT treats physical tokens not as video/action sequence tokens or universal world primitives, but as CWSL-compatible physical WorldStateObjects that preserve the action-relevant distinctions needed to determine physical outcomes under intervention.

papers.title: Effects of body weight support and walking speed on device-derived hip angles and muscle activity symmetry during overground robotic-assisted walking in older adults
papers.summary: Understanding how body weight support (BWS) and walking speed influence gait in older adults may help guide the selection of assistance settings during robotic-assisted gait rehabilitation. These parameters are routinely adjusted during clinical practice, yet their effects during overground robotic-assisted walking remain insufficiently characterized. This study investigated how different levels of BWS and walking speed were associated with device-derived hip angles and bilateral muscle activity symmetry in older adults. papers.title: aletheia-preflight: a deterministic pre-execution safety gate for robot and agent actions
papers.summary: aletheia-preflight is an Apache-2.0 tool that checks a proposed robot or agent action before it runs, grounding it against a stated authority (e.g. an official robot specification) and issuing an audit-grade, content-hashed certificate that says PASS or HOLD with the exact violated constraint localized. First grounded domain: AIRoA MoMa / Toyota HSR mobile manipulation.

papers.title: Robot SF 0.0.6 S30/H600 benchmark dataset
papers.summary: Source-version replication dataset for Robot SF 0.0.6 covering 14 planner arms, 48 social-navigation scenarios, and 30 seeds at horizon 600 with dt=0.1 and differential-drive kinematics (20,160 episode identities). All rows completed without fallback, degraded, unavailable, or failed execution. The Social Navigation Quality Index (SNQI) is advisory only: its v3 rank-alignment contract failed on this campaign, so this release makes no SNQI planner-ranking claim.

papers.title: Large Language Model-Enhanced Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Enterprise Workflow Orchestration via Graph Semantic Routing
papers.summary: # LeMARLA **Large Language Model-Enhanced Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Enterprise Workflow Orchestration via Graph Semantic Routing.** LeMARLA couples an LLM-driven task decomposition module, a heterogeneous graph attention routing module over tasks, employees and skills, and a CTDE multi-agent reinforcement learning policy that consumes the routing scores as a differentiable semantic prior. papers.title: Functional alignment of protein language models via reinforcement learning
papers.summary: Protein language models (pLMs) enable generative design of novel protein sequences but remain fundamentally misaligned with protein engineering goals, as they lack explicit understanding of function and often fail to improve properties beyond those found in nature. papers.title: The entanglement of place in the corporatised governance of schools: Thinking poetically with Barad
papers.summary: In this chapter, through the temporal lens of insight, I argue that place matters in the corporatised governance of schools in England. Drawing on Karen Barad’s (2007) concepts of intra-action and the agential cut, this study, situated in three multi-academy trusts, employs a poetic inquiry approach. Through two agential cuts embodied in distinct poetic forms, I materialise how place entangles with governance policy, architecture, and actors to configure parental engagement.
